email.subject: 5 ways to ace your next technical interview
email.body:
This week on the JobNest blog:

1. Practise thinking out loud
2. Ask clarifying questions before you code
3. Test your solution with small examples
4. Know the trade-offs of your design
5. Prepare two questions for your interviewer
